test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Each passenger __is allows__ one piece of carry - on luggage.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' **i.e. **'Is allowed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the use of **'is allows'** instead of** 'is allowed'. **
 
• **'Allows'** is a present tense verb, while 'allowed' is the past participle used in passive voice sentences.
 
• **'Is allowed' **is the correct form here since we are talking about a permission given to every passenger (the action is performed on the subject – each passenger is being allowed to do something).

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* "Each passenger is allowed one piece of carry-on luggage."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Is allowing'** and **'is allow'** are incorrect because they do not conform to the standard structure of the passive voice that is needed in this context.
